title: Compatible exact shift structures for the pinned right-adjoint tensor comparison
statement: Let $f:Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-scheme]. Fix derived categories in a common localization universe [def-pc-derived-category], derived pullback $L=Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], derived direct image $R=Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and the shared derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Assume $R$ preserves quasi-coherent objects, $\mathcal O_Y$ is quasi-coherent, and $LK\otimes E'$ is quasi-coherent for quasi-coherent $K,E'$. Equip $L$ with the specified monoidal structure, fix $a:L\dashv R$, and fix a right adjoint $c$ to the restriction of $R$ to $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}$, with adjunction $b$. Set $E=c(\mathcal O_Y)$. Let $\tau$ be a natural transformation from the quasi-coherent lift of $K\mapsto LK\otimes E$ to $c$. Assume that for each $K$ there is an isomorphism $p_K:R(LK\otimes E)\cong K\otimes RE$ such that $p_K^{-1}=a.\operatorname{homEquiv}((LK\otimes\epsilon^a_E)\circ\mu_L(K,RE)^{-1})$ and $\tau_K=b.\operatorname{homEquiv}(\rho_K\circ(K\otimes\epsilon^b_{\mathcal O_Y})\circ p_K)$; these are the pinned component equations of [lem-sc-right-adjoint-tensor-comparison-natural]. Give $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ the shift induced by its inclusion $I_Y$ in the ambient category; quasi-coherent cohomology is stable under every integer shift. For the ambient-valued functors $F(K)=LK\otimes E$ and $G(K)=c(K)$ there exist coherent integer shift structures $s_F,s_G$ such that the ambient transformation underlying $\tau$ commutes with these shifts. Moreover, for every triangle $S$ of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$, if $I_Y(S)$ is distinguished in $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ then both $F(S)$ and $G(S)$ are distinguished in $D(\mathcal O_Z)$, using $s_F,s_G$ on their connecting maps. No diagram morphism or vertex-conjugation formula is included in this statement.

proof.text: On K-flat representatives, pullback followed by tensoring with a K-flat representative of E commutes coherently with all integer shifts and sends mapping cones to mapping cones. Localize these comparisons to obtain s_F and the asserted preservation of ambient distinguished triangles with quasi-coherent vertices.

Compute R on injective resolutions to obtain its coherent exact shift structure. Its quasi-coherent restriction is exact because quasi-coherent cohomology is stable under shifts and extensions. Transport shifts through the specified adjunction b using the Hom adjunction and Yoneda. Apply the right-adjoint triangulated-functor argument: complete the image of the first arrow to a triangle, transpose the counit maps to a comparison with c of the original triangle, and use the exact Hom sequences and Yoneda to show that its third component is an isomorphism. The ambient inclusion gives s_G and triangle preservation.

Expand the pinned projection and adjunction-mate component equations. On shifted K-flat representatives move translation through tensor and pullback. Naturality of the counits and both adjunction triangle identities identify the resulting component with the translate of the original component. The zero/addition coherences come from those of the representative shifts. Transport these structures along the monoidal and adjunction comparison isomorphisms for the specified choices; uniqueness of mates preserves the pinned formulas. This gives NatTrans.CommShift for the ambient transformation with s_F and s_G simultaneously. No component of tau is cancelled, so zero objects and zero triangles are included.

theorem rightAdjointTensor_compatibleExactStructures
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [(schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).IsStableUnderShift ℤ]
    (hRf : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj))
    (hO : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y)))
    (hTensor : ∀ (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z),
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ E.obj))
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    (a : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z)
    (adj : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) hRf ⊣ c)
    (τ : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ⋙ derivedPullback f ⋙
        tensorRight (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)
      (fun K ↦ hTensor K (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩))
      ⟶ c)
    (hτ : ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y,
      ∃ pf : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj
            (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ≅
          K.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
        pf.inv = (a.homEquiv _ _)
          ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (derivedPullback f) K.obj
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)).inv ≫
            (derivedPullback f).obj K.obj ◁ a.counit.app (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ∧
        τ.app K = ((adj.homEquiv
          ⟨((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
            hTensor K (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩)⟩ K)
          (ObjectProperty.homMk (pf.hom ≫
            K.obj ◁ (adj.counit.app ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).hom ≫ (ρ_ K.obj).hom)))) :
    let F := (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ⋙ derivedPullback f ⋙
        tensorRight (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)
      (fun K ↦ hTensor K (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩)) ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).ι
    let G := c ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).ι
    ∃ (sF : F.CommShift ℤ) (sG : G.CommShift ℤ),
      letI := sF
      letI := sG
      NatTrans.CommShift (Functor.whiskerRight τ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).ι) ℤ ∧
      ∀ S : Pretriangulated.Triangle (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y),
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι.mapTriangle.obj S ∈
          Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles →
        F.mapTriangle.obj S ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles ∧
        G.mapTriangle.obj S ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles
